name: Mercure Bali Legian
short_description: A Green Key-certified 4-star Mercure on Legian's main street, 7 minutes' walk to Kuta-Legian beach, with a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (320 reviews).
ai_summary: Mercure Bali Legian sits on the main street of Legian, a short stroll from Kuta and Legian beaches and roughly 15 minutes' walk from the Beachwalk shopping centre in Seminyak. The hotel holds a 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 320 reviews and is Green Key certified for its sustainability practices. It's positioned for both business and leisure travellers, from families to honeymooners to corporate guests, and participates in the MyResorts programme offering additional experiences for ALL members. Standard ALL elite benefits apply.

core_facts.address: Jl Legian No 328, Legian Kelod, Kuta, Bali, 80361, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Central Legian location — 7 minutes' walk to Kuta-Legian beach and roughly 15 minutes to Beachwalk shopping in Seminyak
Green Key certified for environmental sustainability, distinct from most budget/midscale Accor properties in the area
cons: Legian's main street location means some traffic noise compared with beachfront-only properties
Midscale Mercure standard — comfortable but not a luxury resort experience
research_highlights: Green Key certified; part of the MyResorts programme
